items.computation: This is a private invoice (Werkvertrag), not a letter from an authority, so no deemed-delivery rule applies. The period starts from the printed Rechnungsdatum 03.08.2026. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event itself (03.08.) is not counted, so counting starts 04.08.2026. 14 days later, under §188 Abs.1 BGB, the period ends on Monday 17.08.2026. That day is a normal working day (not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday), so no §193 BGB shift is needed. Final due date: 17.08.2026 (sending the transfer a business day or two earlier is advisable given §675s BGB bank transfer times, but the legal due date is 17.08.2026).
